title: 第19章 厚土载元身诸多禁忌第20章 土元道种邪魔登场
content_zh:
找到原因，接下来的事情就很简单了。
陆羽只需要去地仙管理局内网app的藏经阁中寻找一门适合自己的功法，修炼一下，平衡一下道土空间内过剩的土行之力就行。
五行生克之中，水火相克，正常情况下，陆羽应该选择一门水行功法。
就是罗悦也都如此建议：
“龙舒城地处通天河南岸，水汽充沛，最适合修行水法，事半功倍，刚好能快速中和你道土内的火气。”
不过陆羽仔细一想，还是摇摇头，拒绝了罗悦的提议。
龙舒城这边水汽充沛不假，但陆羽有采炼天上大日火气的经验，他比谁都清楚，帝国这边的天地灵气远不如异界那边充裕。
而异界蛇信村部族附近既无大江大河，也无湖泊溪流，部族里的人吃水都靠堡垒中的一座深井。
如此情境之下，蛇信村部族附近的水汽，绝不如天上大日火气那般充裕。
若是修行水行功法，水汽部族，并无多少增益，反而会耽误修炼进度。
排除掉水行功法，剩下的便是修行木土金三行功法。
可陆羽转念一想，又立刻否定了木行功法与金行功法。
五行之中木生火，木盛火炽。
他如今道土内的火行已经过旺，若是再修行木行功法，木生火，火行更旺，容易玩火自焚，把自己给点了。
至于金行功法，一来工业金属价格昂贵，修炼所需的金行灵气获取不易。
二来五行之中火克金，金行功法对于平衡火行之力的效果本就并不理想，即便修炼，也难以从根本上解决道土失衡的问题。
如此一来，最适合陆羽的，便是土行功法。
五行之中火生土，土能泄火、伏火、定火。
这种制衡并非像水那样直接“浇灭”火气，而是用土的厚重与包容，去承接、转化、收纳狂乱的火行能量。
让其落地、稳定、归位，从根源上平衡道土内的五行。

更重要的是，异界那边有着广袤无垠的大地，大地土气浓郁且极易获取。
无论何时何地都能采炼滋养，不用受天气、环境限制。
综合来看，此时修行土行功法，对陆羽来说无疑是最好的选择。
心中打定主意，陆羽立刻打开地仙管理局内网app的藏经阁。
他手里恰好还有刚领到的两点功勋，不用再额外攒资源，直接选定了龙舒城本地流传最广、适配道土境修士的基础土行功法。
《厚土载元身》。
这门功法主打采炼大地之气，侧重肉身与道土的双重修行，核心便是以精纯的大地之气淬炼肉身、滋养道土。
久而久之，便能炼出一副立地生根、气力无穷的厚土载元真身。
此法最突出的优势便是防御强悍、续航持久，恰好能弥补陆羽的短板。
此法采炼大地之气，注重肉身修行，以大地之气淬炼肉身道土，炼出一副立地生根，气力无穷的厚土载元真身。
陆羽如今修炼的赤鸦炼日诀，专攻火法，攻伐之威凌厉，仅次于金行功法《锐金破妄诀》。
已具备了强劲的攻伐能力，而《厚土载元身》的防御与持久，刚好与赤鸦炼日诀形成互补，一攻一守，让他的实力更趋均衡。
付了功勋，成功买下功法，陆羽便迫不及待地将心思放在了《厚土载元身》的入门之上。
他仔细研读功法口诀，发现这门基础五行功法的炼法，与赤鸦炼日诀大差不差。
都是从采气入门，通过观想道文炼化天地灵气，最终凝练成对应属性的法力，上手并不算难。
不过与赤鸦炼日诀不同，《厚土载元身》并无配套的道兵之法，它所炼出的土行道种，无需寄托于道兵，而是要直接炼入道土空间与自身身体窍穴之中，让道种、道土与肉身彼此勾连，形成厚土载元真身的根基。
为了尽快入门，陆羽则是下班之后，来到异界。
蛇信村部族之人，听见陆羽说要练法，立刻动员人力，特意给陆羽挖开堡垒的地面，按照他的需求，挖出一个可以直接接触土壤的大坑。
等坑挖好，陆羽遣散众人，从道土中唤出赤鸦道兵，叮嘱它待在附近，警戒放风，防止有部族之人打扰他。
content_en:
Find the reason and the next thing is simple.
Lu Yu only needs to go to the Sutra Pavilion on the intranet app of the Earth Immortal Administration Bureau to find a technique that suits him, practice it, and balance the excess earth power in the earth space.
Among the five elements, water and fire are in conflict with each other. Under normal circumstances, Lu Yu should choose a water element technique.
Even Luo Yue also suggested this:
"Longshu City is located on the south bank of the Tongtian River. It has abundant water vapor. It is most suitable for practicing the water method. It will get twice the result with half the effort. It can quickly neutralize the fire in your Dao soil."
However, Lu Yu thought carefully and shook his head, rejecting Luo Yue's proposal.
It is true that there is abundant water vapor in Longshu City, but Lu Yu has experience in extracting the fire energy of the great sun in the sky. He knows better than anyone that the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the empire is far less abundant than that in the other world.
There are no big rivers, lakes or streams near the tribe of Shexin Village in the Other World. People in the tribe rely on a deep well in the fortress for water.
Under such a situation, the water vapor near the Shexin Village tribe is by no means as abundant as the fire energy of the great sun in the sky.
If you practice the water movement technique, the water vapor tribe will not gain much, but it will delay the progress of your practice.
Excluding the water element exercises, the only thing left is to practice the three elements of wood, earth, and metal.
But after Lu Yu thought about it, he immediately rejected the Wood Walking Technique and the Gold Walking Technique.
Among the five elements, wood generates fire, and wood contains fire.
The fire element in his Dao soil is now too strong. If he continues to practice the wood element method, the wood will generate fire, and the fire element will become more intense. He will easily burn himself with fire and burn himself.
As for the Gold Element Cultivation Technique, industrial metals are expensive and it is difficult to obtain the Gold Element Spiritual Energy required for practice.
Secondly, among the five elements, fire overcomes metal. The effect of the metal element exercises on balancing the power of fire elements is not ideal. Even if they are practiced, it is difficult to fundamentally solve the problem of Tao-earth imbalance.
In this way, the most suitable method for Lu Yu is the earth walking technique.
Among the five elements, fire generates earth, and earth can release fire, subdue fire, and stabilize fire.
This kind of check and balance is not like water directly "dousing" fire, but using the thickness and tolerance of earth to absorb, transform and contain the crazy fire energy.
Let it fall to the ground, stabilize, and return to its position, and balance the five elements in the Tao soil from the root.
More importantly, there is a vast land in the other world, which is rich in rustic flavor and easy to obtain.
It can be extracted and nourished anytime and anywhere without being restricted by weather or environment.
Taken together, it is undoubtedly the best choice for Lu Yu to practice earth walking skills at this time.
Having made up his mind, Lu Yu immediately opened the Sutra Pavilion on the intranet app of the Dixian Administration Bureau.
He happened to still have the two points of merit he had just received, so he did not need to save additional resources, so he directly selected the most widely circulated basic earth movement technique in Longshu City, which is suitable for Taoist monks.
"Thick soil carries the original body".
This technique focuses on extracting the energy of the earth, focusing on the dual cultivation of the physical body and the earth. The core is to use the pure energy of the earth to temper the physical body and nourish the earth.
Over time, you will be able to refine a true body that is rooted in the ground and has infinite power.
The most prominent advantages of this method are its strong defense and long battery life, which can just make up for Lu Yu's shortcomings.
This method collects and refines the energy of the earth, focuses on physical cultivation, uses the energy of the earth to temper the soil of the physical body, and refines a thick earth-bearing true body that takes root on the ground and has infinite power.
The Red Crow Sun Refining Technique that Lu Yu is currently practicing specializes in fire techniques, and its offensive power is fierce, second only to the Jin Xing Technique "Rapid Gold Breaking the Illusion Technique".
Already possessing strong offensive capabilities, the defense and durability of "Thick Earth-carrying Yuan Shen" just complement the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique. One attack and one defense make his strength more balanced.
After paying the merit and successfully purchasing the technique, Lu Yu couldn't wait to focus on getting started with "Thick Earth-Containing Yuan Shen".
He carefully studied the exercises and found that the basic Five Elements exercises were very different from the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique.
They all start with collecting qi and refining the spirit of heaven and earth through contemplating Taoism.Qi is finally condensed into mana with corresponding attributes. It is not difficult to get started.
However, unlike the Red Crow Sun Refining Technique, "Thick Earth-carrying Yuan Shen" does not have a supporting Taoist method. The earth-moving Tao seeds it refines do not need to be entrusted to Tao soldiers, but must be directly refined into the Tao-soil space and the orifices of one's own body, allowing the Tao-seed, Tao-soil and physical body to connect with each other to form the foundation of the thick earth-carrying Yuan Shen.
In order to get started as soon as possible, Lu Yu came to another world after get off work.
When the people from the Shexin Village tribe heard that Lu Yu said he wanted to practice, they immediately mobilized manpower and specially dug the ground of the fortress for Lu Yu. According to his needs, they dug a large pit that could directly touch the soil.
After the pit was dug, Lu Yu dismissed everyone, called the Red Crow Taoist soldiers from the soil, and told them to stay nearby and be alert to prevent tribesmen from disturbing him.
